pr_title: sql: fix panic caused by inject_retry_errors_enabled
pr_body:
fixes https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/83011

In addition to fixing the panic, this also improves the CLI error
reporting a little, which made this easier to debug.

Release note (bug fix): Fixed a panic that could happen if the
inject_retry_errors_enabled setting is true and an INSERT
is executed outside of an explicit transaction.

issue_context.title: inject_retry_errors_enabled crashes a node/cluster on implicit txn
issue_context.body:
**Describe the problem**

Start a demo cluster

```bash
cockroach demo --no-example-database
```

Set the session variable, create a table and attempt to insert without an explicit transaction

```sql
SET inject_retry_errors_enabled = 'true';
CREATE TABLE test (key UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), insert_worked BOOL DEFAULT FALSE);
INSERT INTO test (insert_worked) VALUES ('true');
```

the error is

```sql
*
* ERROR: Queued as error 83c89b2b27fe44cdb535d22700aee2d8
*
```

Tested on `demo` and a single node cluster

**Expected behavior**
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

**Additional data / screenshots**

on a single node cluster

```sql
root@:26257/defaultdb> SET inject_retry_errors_enabled = 'true';
SET


Time: 0ms total (execution 0ms / network 0ms)

root@:26257/defaultdb> INSERT INTO test (insert_worked) VALUES ('true');
*
* ERROR: Queued as error 5b874cc5db844af5bd3492ad87885c3f
*
ERROR: driver: bad connection
warning: connection lost!
opening new connection: all session settings will be lost
warning: error retrieving the transaction status: dial tcp [::1]:26257: connect: connection refused
warning: connection lost!
opening new connection: all session settings will be lost
warning: error retrieving the database name: dial tcp [::1]:26257: connect: connection refused
root@:26257/? ?> 
```

If a node in your cluster encountered a fatal error, supply the contents of the
log directories (at minimum of the affected node(s), but preferably all nodes).

Note that log files can contain confidential information. Please continue
creating this issue, but contact support@cockroachlabs.com to submit the log
files in private.

**Environment:**
 - CockroachDB version 22.1.1
 - Server OS: OSX 12.4
 - Client app `cockroach sql`




Jira issue: CRDB-16795
